Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?

Sees(cow, dog, True) ::: The cow sees the dog.

Likes(dog, lion, True) ::: The dog likes the lion.

Rough(lion, True) ::: The lion is rough.
Needs(lion, dog, False) ::: The lion does not need the dog.

Needs(rabbit, cow, True) ::: The rabbit needs the cow.

Sees(rabbit, dog, True) ::: The rabbit sees the dog.

Likes($x, cow, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: If someone likes the cow then they are big.
Needs($x, lion, True) >>> Needs(lion, cow, True) ::: If someone needs the lion then the lion needs the cow.
Likes($x, lion, True) >>> Likes($x, rabbit, True) ::: If someone likes the lion then they like the rabbit.
Sees($x, cow, True) && Big($x, False) >>> Likes($x, lion, False) ::: If someone sees the cow and they are not big then they do not like the lion.
Green($x, True) >>> Sees($x, rabbit, True) ::: If someone is green then they see the rabbit.
Green($x, True) && Likes($x, cow, True) >>> Needs(cow, rabbit, True) ::: If someone is green and they like the cow then the cow needs the rabbit.

Likes($x, lion, True) && Likes($x, rabbit, True) >>> Green(lion, True) ::: If someone likes the lion and they like the rabbit then the lion is green.

Query:
Likes(lion, rabbit, False) ::: The lion does not like the rabbit.
